title: Language Family Matters: Evaluating LLM-Based ASR Across Linguistic Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2601.18899v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-powered Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems achieve strong performance with limited resources by linking a frozen speech encoder to a pretrained LLM via a lightweight connector. Prior work trains a separate connector per language, overlooking linguistic relatedness. We propose an efficient and novel connector-sharing strategy based on linguistic family membership, enabling one connector per family, and empirically validate its effectiveness across two multilingual LLMs and two real-world corpora spanning curated and crowd-sourced speech. Our results show that family-based connectors reduce parameter count while improving generalization across domains, offering a practical and scalable strategy for multilingual ASR deployment.

translated_title: 语言家族的重要性：跨语言边界评估基于大语言模型的自动语音识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.18899v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动语音识别（ASR）系统通过轻量级连接器将冻结的语音编码器与预训练LLM相连，在有限资源下实现了强劲性能。先前的工作为每种语言单独训练一个连接器，忽略了语言间的相关性。我们提出了一种基于语言家族成员关系的高效且新颖的连接器共享策略，使每个家族仅需一个连接器，并在两个多语言LLM和两个涵盖精选及众包语音的真实世界语料库上实证验证了其有效性。我们的结果表明，基于家族的连接器减少了参数数量，同时提升了跨领域的泛化能力，为多语言ASR部署提供了一种实用且可扩展的策略。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于语言家族共享连接器的策略，减少了参数数量并提升了跨领域泛化能力，为多语言ASR提供了高效可扩展的方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a family-based connector-sharing strategy that reduces parameters and improves cross-domain generalization, offering an efficient and scalable solution for multilingual ASR.
